# Implementation Notes

## Identifiers

The function clip_grad_norm limits the global gradient magnitude. The
configuration field maximum_norm stores the threshold used by that operation.

## Acronym

Reciprocal rank fusion is abbreviated RRF. It combines ranked candidate lists
through reciprocal functions of their ranks without adding incompatible raw
scores.

## Misleading Overlap

A future rate forecast may discuss later positions in an economic table, but
those words do not describe causal decoder attention or neural-network
information flow.

## Retrieval Limits

Latent semantic analysis is corpus dependent and linear. Similarity in its
latent coordinates does not prove that a passage is relevant or that a claim
is factually supported.
